statements.statement: Preliminary FY27 budget presented to the finance committee on Feb 19 showed a deficit of $3,357,213.88.
After the school department adjusted its budget (presented to FINCOM), the current deficit is reduced to $3,150,993.89.
The FY27 omnibus budget article is for the balance budget that is not override dependent; no specific override articles have been discussed yet.
Salary Administrative Plan (SAP) cost-of-living adjustment for FY27 is currently being looked at around 3%, with HR doing further analysis.
A warrant article will appropriate the town's standard policy percentage of available free cash to the OPEB trust fund; no dollar figure stated.
A warrant article proposes putting another $10,000 into the compensated absences fund (started last year with $10,000) to cover unforeseen departure liabilities.
A member stated there will be a need for an override to cover expenses that can't be accommodated in the budget for the school budget and for the fire department's proposed fourth shift.
A board member noted the town will be presenting a balanced budget number that would mean major service cuts townwide.
The school committee's FY27 budget hearing presented a needs-based restoration budget totaling approximately $980,000.
